title: Quart

inlines.v: QUART, noun quort. [Latin quartus.] 1. The fourth part; a quarter. [Not in use.] 2. The fourth part of a gallon; two pints. 3. A vessel containing the fourth of a gallon. 4. A sequence of four cards in the game of picket.
